placeholders.<cargo-home>: the host's Cargo home; the path that follows is kept
placeholders.<lean-toolchain>/: the absolute host directory of the Lean 4.33.0 toolchain the check invoked; the path that follows is kept
placeholders.<repository>: the absolute host directory of the repository's main checkout; the path that follows (a tracked path, or a worktree or private run directory under .local/) is kept
placeholders.<rustup>: the host's rustup home; the toolchain path that follows is kept

rule: each absolute host prefix below is replaced by its placeholder, the longer prefixes first; no other byte changes. The placeholders do not occur in the originals, so substituting each prefix back restores the original bytes, whose sha256 and size are pinned here; checked locally before commit. The originals stay in local custody.
